title: QI-VC Common Definitions
description: Reusable $defs shared across QI-VC credential schemas. Not a standalone credential schema.

BitstringStatusListEntry.title: BitstringStatusListEntry
BitstringStatusListEntry.description: Credential status entry per W3C Bitstring Status List v1.0 (https://www.w3.org/TR/vc-bitstring-status-list/).

id.description: URL identifying this status entry, including the list index as a fragment.

type.description: Fixed value per W3C Bitstring Status List v1.0 §2.1.

statusPurpose.description: Purpose of the status entry per W3C Bitstring Status List v1.0 §2.1.

statusListIndex.description: Zero-based integer index into the bitstring, as a string.

statusListCredential.description: URL of the BitstringStatusListCredential that contains this entry's bit.

DataIntegrityProof.title: DataIntegrityProof
DataIntegrityProof.description: Cryptographic proof per W3C Data Integrity 1.0 (https://www.w3.org/TR/vc-data-integrity/).

type.description: Fixed value per W3C Data Integrity §2.1.

cryptosuite.description: Cryptosuite identifier. eddsa-rdfc-2022 (Ed25519 + URDNA2015) is preferred.

proofPurpose.description: Proof purpose per W3C Data Integrity §2.1. Always assertionMethod for issued credentials.

verificationMethod.description: DID URL of the verification method (public key) used to create the proof.

created.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the proof was created.

proofValue.description: Multibase-encoded proof value (base58btc, prefix 'z'). eddsa-rdfc-2022 Data Integrity proof implemented in M2.

DigestBinding.title: DigestBinding
DigestBinding.description: Cryptographic binding to a referenced credential. digestMultibase is the SHA-256 of the URDNA2015 canonical form encoded in multibase base58btc.

digestAlgorithm.description: Hash algorithm per IANA Named Information Hash Algorithm Registry (https://www.iana.org/assignments/named-information/).

digestMultibase.description: SHA-256 digest of the URDNA2015 canonical form of the referenced credential (proof block excluded), encoded in multibase base58btc (prefix 'z').

Unit.title: Unit
Unit.description: Unit of measurement. ucumCode (UCUM) for human-readable display; unitIri (QUDT v2.1) for linked-data semantics. At least one MUST be present.

ucumCode.description: Unified Code for Units of Measure (UCUM) code, e.g. 'bar', 'Pa', 'kg', '1' (dimensionless).

unitIri.description: QUDT v2.1 unit URI, e.g. 'http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/BAR'. Pattern: http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/[SYMBOL].

MeasurementUncertainty.title: MeasurementUncertainty
MeasurementUncertainty.description: Measurement uncertainty per GUM (JCGM 100:2008) and PTB D-SI XSD v2.2.1 (https://ptb.de/si).

standardUncertainty.description: Standard uncertainty u(x) — estimated standard deviation of the measurement result. GUM §4.

expandedUncertainty.description: Expanded uncertainty U = k·u(x). GUM §6. D-SI si:expandedUnc.uncertainty.

coverageFactor.description: Coverage factor k used to compute U from u(x). GUM §6.2. D-SI si:coverageFactor.

coverageProbability.description: Coverage probability p associated with the expanded uncertainty interval, e.g. 0.95 for 95 %. GUM §6.2. D-SI si:coverageProbability.

Quantity.title: Quantity
Quantity.description: A measured physical quantity with kind, value, unit, and optional uncertainty. Maps to D-SI si:quantity and QUDT qudt:Quantity.

quantityKind.description: QUDT v2.1 QuantityKind URI identifying what is being measured, e.g. 'http://qudt.org/vocab/quantitykind/Pressure'. Pattern: http://qudt.org/vocab/quantitykind/[Kind].

value.description: Numeric measurement result. Maps to D-SI si:value / QUDT qudt:numericValue.

PhysicalQuantity.title: PhysicalQuantity
PhysicalQuantity.description: A physical quantity with optional name label. Used for influence conditions (environmental parameters).

name.description: Human-readable label for this condition, e.g. 'Ambient temperature'.

ContactInfo.title: ContactInfo
ContactInfo.description: Contact information for an organization or person. Maps to dcc:contactType in PTB DCC XSD v3.3.0.

id.description: Optional DID or URI for this entity.

name.description: Full legal name of the organization or person.

Identification.title: Identification
Identification.description: An identifier for an item, with type and value. Maps to dcc:identification in PTB DCC XSD v3.3.0.

CapabilityCredentialReference.title: CapabilityCredentialReference
CapabilityCredentialReference.description: Evidence reference from a domain credential to the CapabilityCredential that authorized its issuance. Contains a cryptographic hashBinding.

type.description: Fixed type identifier for this evidence entry.

hashBinding.description: SHA-256 of URDNA2015 canonical form of the referenced CapabilityCredential (proof excluded), multibase base58btc.

VcContext.title: VcContext
VcContext.description: The @context array for a VC 2.0 credential. First item MUST be the W3C VC 2.0 context.

VcType.title: VcType
VcType.description: The type array for a VC 2.0 credential. MUST contain 'VerifiableCredential'.

Issuer.title: Issuer
Issuer.description: The issuer of the credential. Either a DID/URI string or an object with an 'id' property.

oneOf.description: DID or HTTPS URL identifying the issuer.
